workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Playwright Test Agent mode translates business user stories into comprehensive, maintainable end-to-end tests using Playwright Test framework with Page Object Model patterns.

step.details: Parse the user story to identify: - User role and persona - Action to be performed - Expected outcome - Acceptance criteria
Review existing test structure: - tests/e2e/ui/ directory structure - Page Object Models in tests/e2e/ui/pages/ - Test fixtures in tests/e2e/ui/conftest.py - Helper functions in tests/e2e/ui/tasks/

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze user story and map to test requirements

steps.step: Identify UI elements and interactions from the story
Map user actions to Playwright locators and methods
Define expected assertions for each step
Use web-crawler skill to fetch Playwright docs
Convert documentation to markdown using web-to-markdown skill
Extract relevant patterns for locators, assertions, and fixtures
Create or update Page Object Model for new UI components
Write test file with descriptive test names
Implement test with proper fixtures and assertions
Add test documentation with FN: headers
Check test follows Playwright best practices
Verify locators are resilient and semantic
Ensure assertions are specific and meaningful

completion_criteria.criterion: User story fully covered by test scenarios
Page Object Model created/updated for UI components
